en.title: AI Act after the Digital Omnibus: Article 49(4)(b) still lists point 9 of Annex VIII, Section B, which was deleted
en.summary: Article 1, point (42), of Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 deleted points 7 and 9 of Annex VIII, Section B. Article 49(4)(b) still lists points 8 and 9 of Section B. This has been noted publicly before.
en.impact: For a system registered in the secure non-public section, one listed field no longer exists.
en.correction: Amend Article 49(4)(b) to refer to Section B, points 1 to 5 and point 8, of Annex VIII.
